drafts.title: Winter on I-70: 46 fast-charge stops, one 43-mile gap home
drafts.angle: Winter is here. Real numbers on what cold does to range, and why the Denver to Grand Junction drive is no longer scary in an EV.
bullets: Denver to Grand Junction is 243 miles on I-70; DOE data shows 46 DC fast-charge locations and 258 ports within 3 miles of the road (ChargingNear.me, updated Nov 12).
Longest gap on the route: 43 miles, Parachute to Grand Junction.
Recurrent (30,000-car study): EVs keep about 78% of range at 32F and about 70% at 20F; Teslas rank among the best.
DOE: preconditioning while plugged in can save up to 20% battery energy on short trips at 20F.
Colorado has about 486 public fast-charging locations; 83% of state highways are within 30 miles of one (CDOT, Aug 2026).
drafts.body: {my winter range drop}% less range on my Tesla this week. Normal for cold. Denver to Grand Junction now has 46 fast-charge stops on I-70. Longest gap: 43 miles, Parachute to home. My trick: warm it up while plugged in. {app photo} What is your winter range hit?
drafts.framework_body:
{my winter range drop}% less range on my Tesla this week.

That is normal. Cold batteries hold less. A big study of 30,000 cars found EVs keep about 78% of their range at freezing and about 70% at 20 degrees.

Here is why I do not sweat it anymore. Denver to Grand Junction is 243 miles on I-70 and there are now 46 fast-charge stops along the way. The longest gap is 43 miles, Parachute to home.

My winter routine:
1. Warm the car up while it is still plugged in. Uses wall power, not battery.
2. Heated seat and wheel before cabin heat.
3. Navigate to the charger so the battery warms on the way.
4. Leave it plugged in overnight at {my charge limit}%.

{photo of frost on the car or the app preconditioning}

What is your winter range hit?

drafts.title: Pick a family safe word before Thanksgiving
drafts.angle: AI can copy a voice from a few seconds of video. The fix is free and takes two minutes at the Thanksgiving table.
bullets: FBI: Americans lost more than $893M to AI-related scams last year, including voice cloning (via KRCU consumer handbook).
INTERPOL's new campaign: "Wait. Validate. Don't take the bait." Red flags: urgency, secrecy, gift cards, crypto, wire transfers. Advice includes a family safe word.
How it works: pick a word only family knows, share it in person, and if a caller cannot say it, hang up and call back on a number you already have.
Nov 13 five used FBI 60+ numbers, so keep this one about the safe word, not the stats.
drafts.body: $893 million lost to AI scams last year. A lot of it was fake voices of family. The fix is free: a family safe word. Pick it at Thanksgiving. Say it out loud, never text it. No word, hang up and call back. Does your family have one yet?
drafts.framework_body:
$893 million.

That is what Americans lost to AI scams last year, per the FBI. A lot of it started with a phone call that sounded exactly like a son, a daughter, a grandkid.

AI can copy a voice from a few seconds of video. That part is scary. The fix is not.

Pick a family safe word. One word only your family knows.

Rules:
1. Pick it in person. Thanksgiving dinner is perfect.
2. Never text it or post it.
3. If someone calls in a panic and cannot say it, hang up and call them back on the number you already have.

Takes two minutes. Costs nothing. {my one-line reason this matters to me}

Does your family have one yet?

drafts.pixel: Kitchen table: "Before Thanksgiving, do this one thing with your family. Takes two minutes."
drafts.premium_target: Quote any verified creator posting a voice-clone scam story: "This is why every family needs a safe word. Free, two minutes."

drafts.title: A $1-plus per kWh fast-charge warning, and why home charging still wins
drafts.angle: A UK report warns fast charging could hit about 1 pound per kWh in 2027 while home overnight there is 6.5p. US lesson: the savings live in your garage.
bullets: Report "Reverse the Charge" (The Fast Charge + Zest, Nov 11): fixed grid charge on one rapid charger up 616% since 2021; modeled cost 1.03 pounds/kWh at a quiet charger. A model, not an announced price.
Zapmap average UK rapid price today: 82p/kWh. Home overnight tariff: 6.5p (Octopus).
Per mile: about 1.9p at home vs 23.4p at 82p (EV Compared math). Home charging is not hit by these grid charges.
Nov 13 five did a $61.86 fast-charge receipt; lead with the UK number as the fresh hook, not a rehash.

drafts.title: Diesel is still $6.13. That is in your grocery bill.
drafts.angle: Gas is falling, diesel is not. Every truck that stocks the store pays it. Electric semis are the quiet fix.
bullets: EIA (Nov 9 week): US diesel $6.127/gal, up $2.29 from a year ago. Rocky Mountain $6.206.
Same week: Colorado regular gas $3.746, down 32 cents in a week.
Einride is deploying 500 Tesla Semis for Amazon and other shippers: about 75 by end of 2026, the rest by end of 2027 (Einride press release Aug 18; CEO to FreightWaves).
Shippers say the sweet spot is 150 to 300-mile daily routes; fuel and maintenance savings beat diesel after about three years (Fast Company, Sep).
drafts.body: $6.13 a gallon. That is diesel right now, up $2.29 in a year. Gas in Colorado just fell to {$X.XX at my station}. Diesel did not. Every truck that stocks our grocery store pays that. 500 Tesla Semis are headed to Amazon routes. Seeing it in your grocery bill?
drafts.framework_body:
$6.13 a gallon.

That is the national average for diesel right now. Up $2.29 from a year ago. Out here in the Rockies it is $6.21.

Gas is finally coming down. I paid {$X.XX at my station} this week. Diesel did not follow.

Why that matters to your family: every truck that stocks the grocery store, delivers your packages, and hauls the lumber runs on it. That cost lands on the shelf price.

The quiet fix is already rolling. 500 Tesla Semis are headed to Amazon and other shipping routes, about 75 by the end of this year. Shippers say they beat diesel on cost in about three years.
